channel.title: Coincide blog
channel.description: Feature videos, launch notes and deep dives on Coincide, the native Mac app for coding agents.

item.title: Swift. AppKit. No Electron.
item.description: A 10-second preview of Coincide’s native Swift and AppKit interface: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, with a conversation that stays together.

item.title: One picker for your coding agents
item.description: A 12-second preview of Coincide’s agent and model picker: choose Claude Code, Codex or Cursor without leaving your conversation.

item.title: Coding agents with a face: meet the Coincide bots
item.description: Bots in Coincide are coding agents with a face: a character, a personality and standing instructions, on the agent, model and folder you pick.

item.title: How I hand one conversation between Claude Code, Codex and four other coding agents
item.description: How Coincide hands one thread between Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode and Antigravity: per-agent sessions, recaps and their budget.

item.title: Introducing Coincide
item.description: Coincide launched November 1, 2026: a free, open-source Mac app that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode and Antigravity in one window.
